Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.basic.find

Enum Class FindStrategy

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<FindStrategy>
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.basic.find.FindStrategy
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<FindStrategy>, Constable
public enum FindStrategy extends Enum<FindStrategy>
Defines the various strategies available for find operations in Brobot.

This enum consolidates all find strategies that were previously scattered across different options classes. It provides a unified type system for find operations while maintaining backward compatibility with the original ActionConfig.Find enum.

Each strategy represents a different approach to finding elements on the screen, from basic pattern matching to advanced motion detection and color analysis.

Since:
2.0

  • Enum Constant Details

    • FIRST

      public static final FindStrategy FIRST
      Returns the first match found. Stops searching once any Pattern finds a match, making it efficient for existence checks.

    • EACH

      public static final FindStrategy EACH
      Returns one match per Image object. The DoOnEach option in PatternFindOptions determines whether to return the first or best match per Image.

    • ALL

      public static final FindStrategy ALL
      Returns all matches for all Patterns across all Images. Useful for counting or processing multiple instances of an element.

    • BEST

      public static final FindStrategy BEST
      Performs an ALL search then returns only the match with the highest similarity score.

    • UNIVERSAL

      public static final FindStrategy UNIVERSAL
      Used for mocking. Initializing an Image with a UNIVERSAL Find allows it to be accessed by any find operation type.

    • CUSTOM

      public static final FindStrategy CUSTOM
      User-defined find strategy. Must be registered with FindStrategyRegistry before use.

    • COLOR

      public static final FindStrategy COLOR
      Finds regions based on color analysis using k-means clustering, mean color statistics, or classification.

    • HISTOGRAM

      public static final FindStrategy HISTOGRAM
      Matches regions based on histogram similarity from the input images.

    • MOTION

      public static final FindStrategy MOTION
      Finds the locations of a moving object across consecutive screens.

    • REGIONS_OF_MOTION

      public static final FindStrategy REGIONS_OF_MOTION
      Finds all dynamic pixel regions from a series of screens.

    • FIXED_PIXELS

      public static final FindStrategy FIXED_PIXELS
      Returns a mask of all pixels that remain unchanged and a corresponding Match list from the contours.

    • DYNAMIC_PIXELS

      public static final FindStrategy DYNAMIC_PIXELS
      Returns a mask of all pixels that have changed and a corresponding Match list from the contours.

    • ALL_WORDS

      public static final FindStrategy ALL_WORDS
      Finds all words and their regions. Each word is returned as a separate Match object. For finding all text in a specific region as one Match, use a normal Find operation.

    • SIMILAR_IMAGES

      public static final FindStrategy SIMILAR_IMAGES
      Finds images in the second ObjectCollection that are above a similarity threshold to images in the first ObjectCollection.

    • STATES

      public static final FindStrategy STATES
      Analyzes ObjectCollections containing screen images and screenshots to produce states with StateImage objects. Returns Match objects holding the state owner's name and Pattern.
